immutable_rule_summary: Offline simulation does not require live odds unless an experiment specifically tests odds.
Odds belong at the live/manual purchase boundary and may be checked against minimum required odds.
For forward-style backtests/prospective tests, results remain hidden until predictions are frozen.
Exact circumference is preserved; no 335->333 or 500->400 coercion.
No guessing missing PRE fields; no post-outcome cherry-picking; no retune inside confirmatory/prospective sets.
GitHub is canonical continuity state; chat is not long-term memory.
